title: Japanese Salted Steamed Edamame
summary: A simple Japanese snack of tender edamame pods steamed until bright green and tossed with salt and a little sesame oil. It is quick, vegan, savoury, and ideal as a light appetiser or nibble.
steps: Bring 2 cm of water to a boil in a saucepan fitted with a steamer basket.
Add the frozen edamame pods to the steamer basket, cover, and steam for 5–6 minutes until the pods are bright green and the beans inside are hot and tender.
Transfer the edamame to a bowl, drizzle with the sesame oil, sprinkle with the salt, and toss well while hot so the seasoning clings to the pods.
Serve warm or at room temperature. To eat, squeeze the beans from the pods and discard the pods.
